title: 掛紙
mood: cold, murmured, waiting for an answer
subject: sweeping a grave, weighting the paper down and waiting for the wind to make it answer
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien folktronica, cold and murmured. A vocoder pad built from the lead vocal itself, percussion finger-tapped by hand rather than sampled so the timing breathes, upright piano run through glitch and automated filtering, hillside field recordings of wind and birds woven into the bed, one wooden acoustic instrument against the synthesis. Cold and sparse and wide, the voice dry and intimate against processed space. Female voice, murmured and close with almost no projection, doubled an octave up by the vocoder on the chorus. 88 BPM, A minor. Cold, waiting for an answer that will not come. No drum kit, no four-on-the-floor, no pop chorus, no traditional funeral percussion, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
山路細 車停跤 行上去二十分鐘
草長到膝頭 阮用手挽 刀仔無帶
阿爸挽的比阮較緊 伊做過工
阮做了十分鐘 手就紅

[Pre-Chorus]
石頭頂的字 阮用手摸
摸著彼個「氏」字 彼字阮逐年攏摸

[Chorus]
掛紙 硩石頭 一張一張
風若來 紙會響 響起來真像有人應
阮知影無人應 阮猶是等
逐年阮攏等彼聲

[Verse]
阿爸和石頭講話 用台語 講真細聲
阮聽無 阮無想欲聽
伊講完 伊徛一分鐘 伊才回身
伊回身的時 伊共阮講「好啦」

[Chorus]
掛紙 硩石頭 一張一張
風若來 紙會響 響起來真像有人應
阮知影無人應 阮猶是等
明年阮閣會等彼聲

[Outro]
落山的路 較好行
阿爸行頭前 阮看著伊的頭毛
